problem:
Suppose we wish to find a zero of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[-3,0]\times [0,3]⊆{R}^{2},$ where

$$
f(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}{y}^{3}-x+{y}^{4}-3 \\ {x}^{3}-2xy+{y}^{2}+1\end{aligned}].
$$

Calculate the second iteration of the Newton-Raphson process that starts at ${x}_{0}=[-1,\,0]^{T}$ if the first iteration of the algorithm gives ${x}_{1}=[-3,\,3]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to three decimal places (if needed).

| ${x}_{2}\,≈[$ | $-2.621$ | $]$ |
